# Sized Xor first-source context

Informed development on 2026-09-29 after the user authorized implementation of
the complete v0.2.1 plan with corpus completion as the active goal. The existing
30 finite translations, original Qualtran Xor source, desired shared-QPE draft,
structural port rules and review fixes were already known. No external model
was invoked; no controlled model-success claim is made.

The obligation to remove is duplicated fixed-width gate bodies and manual tuple
routing. One source must work at n=1,2,4,8, plus a local n=0 ownership boundary.
The full contract is |x,y> -> |x,y xor x> with phase +1 and arbitrary references.
Wrong paired axes, discarded/duplicated zero-width owners and a phase mutation
must reject the required contract. A zero-input measurement alone is inadequate.

This snapshot intentionally uses desired static naturals and ownership folds,
not supported grammar. The hierarchy proof/binding prerequisites and G020-1
specification must pass before source implementation. The current 0.2.1 working
tree includes earlier uncommitted corpus, reshape and review work. The baseline
commit identifies repository history, not a clean-tree benchmark. The first
source is saved and hashed before the following check.
